metadata.title: UMOA Banking Intelligence
metadata.description: Financial intelligence platform for WAEMU (UMOA) banks and regulators
metadata.keywords: UMOA, WAEMU, BCEAO, banks, financial data, West Africa, deals

sidebar.notice_body: Data from BCEAO, UMOA Banking Commission publications and institutions' reports. Missing data is shown as "—".

topbar.search_placeholder: Search a bank, a deal, an ISIN, a document…

guide.title: Welcome to UMOA Banking Intelligence
guide.intro: Visit the platform pages and learn what their main filters and tools are for.
guide.target_loading: Opening the page and locating its controls…

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: The home page summarizes collected indicators, regional aggregates, and coverage. Choose a fiscal year to see data published for that year; the current and previous years are offered automatically.

search.title: Global search
search.body: Search for a bank by name or acronym, a deal, an ISIN, a source, or a document. Open a result to view its details.

deals.title: Transactions
deals.body: Filter recorded deals by country, type, year, or status. Open a deal to review its sources and supporting evidence.

targeting.title: Funding counterparties
targeting.body: Describe a financing need by country, sector, and deal type. The page shows banks and institutions with documented criteria; unknown information stays marked as unknown.

syndication.title: Syndication
syndication.body: Follow mandates, lenders, terms, and contacts entered internally. This information is confidential and restricted to authorized staff.

institutions.title: Institution directory
institutions.body: Filter institutions by name, country, or status. Open a profile to see financial statements, ratios, charts, and related documents.

countries.title: UMOA countries
countries.body: Compare aggregates and coverage across the Union’s eight countries. Open a country to see its institutions and available market shares.

financial_data.title: Financial data
financial_data.body: Explore financial line items by institution, fiscal year, scope, and period. Check quality status and provenance to find the source document.

documents.title: Document center
documents.body: Find collected publications by filtering document type and fiscal year. The columns show download and extraction status.

rankings.title: Descriptive rankings
rankings.body: Rank published values by metric, fiscal year, and scope. Rankings describe the available figures and are not a qualitative assessment.

analytics.title: Analytics and ratios
analytics.body: Review ratios, year-over-year changes, and sector aggregates. Calculations use the fiscal years and observations that are actually available.

comparisons.title: Comparisons
comparisons.body: Select several institutions to examine their indicators for the same fiscal year. Missing values remain marked as unavailable.

data_quality.title: Data quality
data_quality.body: Review flagged data, conflicting values, and their provenance. The review queue helps you verify evidence before assigning a status.

settings.title: Collections and settings
settings.body: Choose a source and scope, then start a collection. You can select a full year, follow progress live, and review the run history. A run stuck for more than six hours is automatically closed as failed so the next collection can start.

footer.disclaimer: Data from official publications. No extrapolation or interpolation: a missing value is shown as "—".

rankings.title: Descriptive rankings
rankings.subtitle: Numerical order of published values for one indicator, year, period and scope. No qualitative judgement.
rankings.method_note: Rank = position of the value in the chosen order. Equal values share a rank (1, 1, 3). One authoritative value per institution; rejected, divergent or under-review values are excluded; no currency conversion.

ranking_reasons.no_data: No financial data stored for this institution

comparisons.title: Factual comparisons
comparisons.subtitle: Values of 2 to 5 institutions on the same indicator, fiscal year, period and scope, then institution ↔ sector and country ↔ UMOA.
comparisons.method_note: Differences are numerical differences with the first institution. No currency conversion; a non-homogeneous comparison is not computed.
comparisons.select_hint: Choose 2 to 5 institutions to display their values.
comparisons.sector_note: Individual annual accounts, as for sector aggregates.

data_explorer.note_value_sort: Sorted by value: rows are grouped by currency; values in different currencies are not compared.

data_quality.title: Data quality & review center
data_quality.subtitle: Observations needing a human decision: needs review and divergent values.
data_quality.note: Every decision (review, verify, reject) is a traced human action: reason, identifier, date, status before and after. No observation is promoted automatically.
data_quality.auth_note: The platform has no authentication: the identifier you enter is recorded as entered.

targeting.title: Funding counterparties
targeting.subtitle: For a deal profile, the banks and financing institutions with explicit criteria and their evidence. No score: each criterion is met, not met or unknown.
targeting.method: Display order: number of criteria met, then number of comparable deals, then name. A deal "to confirm" has not been reviewed yet. No currency conversion.

syndication.title: Syndication
syndication.subtitle: TOMASTEED's internal tracking of the deals it arranges: institutions approached, appetite, commitments and terms, as entered in the syndication file or in the platform. Internal data, never published.
syndication.confidential: TOMASTEED internal data (including personal data): restricted access, do not share.
syndication.not_linked: to be linked to the directory
syndication.empty_hint: Import the tracking file from Settings → Import the syndication tracker.

import.title: Import the syndication tracker
import.hint: Upload the latest version of the “Suivi de Syndication” Excel file. A preview shows what will be created, updated or in conflict; nothing is written before you confirm.
import.already_imported: This exact file was already imported.
import.preview_error: The file could not be analysed (structure not recognised or API unavailable).
import.apply_error: The import failed: nothing was written.
import.detail_sheets_hint: Tell which deal each detailed tracking sheet belongs to (it is never linked by guess), then recompute the preview.
import.unresolved: {count} institution(s) not linked to the directory
import.unresolved_hint: They are imported with their name as written. To link them, add an exact alias in reference/syndication_aliases.json.
import.conflicts_hint: These values were changed in the platform AND in the file since the last import. Choose which one to keep; the other stays in the history.
